title: Attached files belong to the shop and stay when the template is republished
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A template with reference-file attachments; a second shop; and a template that will be republished.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm attached files are available only within the shop that uploaded them.
2. Republish the template and confirm instructions in earlier published versions still open their attachments.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Attached files are available only within the shop that uploaded them.
  • After a template is republished, instructions in earlier published versions still open their attachments.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9109 (S11 — Attach a reference file to a question); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S11; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R7: “Attached files will be available only within the shop that uploaded them”
  • S11-R8: “After a template is republished, instructions in earlier published versions will still open their attachments”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
